publication_record.source_provenance: Locally authored isolated Uiua source using pure composition of the ordinary array/block and spawn/wait operations qualified by v4.
adaptations: Whole-block numeric-stage factoradic gather; explicit at-most-eight disjoint global-rank workers.
publication_record.timing_boundary: Three actual fresh N12 processes per profile. All 479001600 global ranks are materialized, every actual prefix reversal finishes, checksum uses global parity. Whole-process timing includes startup, source compilation where applicable, explicit worker startup/join, complete output and shutdown. Hashing, qualification and pin checks are excluded.

runtime.provenance: Official Uiua ARM64 macOS release binary; not a locally compiled substitute.
runtime.system_library_policy: macOS platform libraries are supplied by the recorded host OS; no additional non-system runtime dylib is linked by Uiua.

algorithm.reason: The Mech program enumerates all factorial permutations in the required factoradic order, performs actual prefix flips, and reduces the alternating checksum and maximum. Parallel ranges cover the full permutation domain.
